intl_established_fa.summary.title.v2: KBO clubs get first look at international FA pool
intl_established_fa.summary.body:
The {season} international established FA class has been generated. The current pool shows {total_count} market candidates.

This does not mean anyone has signed yet, but it gives KBO clubs a fresh group to sort for foreign-player needs as the FA filing calendar opens.

Notable candidates
{player_list}
Clubs will now weigh position, age, Asian-quota status and expected acquisition cost before deciding which names are worth early contact.

intl_established_fa.summary.body.v2:
The international FA board for {season} is open, with {total_count} candidates currently visible to the market.

For clubs reviewing foreign-player options, this is the first pass at the next shopping list rather than a signing announcement. Scouting departments can now compare position need, age, Asian-quota fit and expected price.

Notable candidates
{player_list}
The earliest movement will likely come from clubs with a clear roster hole and enough budget space to act.
intl_established_fa.summary.body.v3:
A fresh {season} international FA pool has been published. The generated list includes {total_count} players who may draw KBO interest.

The names are not commitments, but they give clubs a practical market map as offseason planning begins. Teams looking to change the foreign-player mix can start sorting the group by role, risk and acquisition cost.

Notable candidates
{player_list}
